Sparkling Tones for desktop, part three: library and banks.
Your library sits on the right: click a preset to play it.
Type a few letters to find a preset by name.
The three dots open more actions: rename, copy, put it in a slot, and more.
Banks are your set lists: eight sounds each, picked from your library and arranged by drag and drop.
